title: Twelve White Cups  (十二个白茶杯)

segments.t: 在集市广场阳光明媚的角落里，凯莱布正在笔记本上画着一道石拱门，这时汉娜和泰莎来到了陶瓷摊位前。请先完整听一遍这段对话。
Look at all these cups, Tessa: tall blue mugs, thin glass cups, round white bowls!
Thin cups look pretty, Hannah, but tea goes cold in three minutes.
Try the thick cream-white stoneware on the left shelf.
Oh, hello, Caleb! Your brother is right behind us holding the honey.
Feel the handle on this cup. Thick clay holds heat and never chips easily.
And listen to that soft clink when you set it on the saucer!
Quiet saucers mean guests can hear Evelyn's piano across the room.
Even when buying teacups, Caleb thinks like an acoustic architect!
If we buy twelve cups and twelve saucers together, is there a discount?
Look at the chalk sign: ten percent off a full dozen!
Plus a matching white milk jug on the side. Wrap them in newspaper.
Packed and paid! Do not forget Graham's black tape on the way home!
现在我们来逐句解析这段对话。
Look at all these cups, Tessa: tall blue mugs, thin glass cups, round white bowls!
“快看这些杯子，泰莎：高高的蓝色马克杯、精致的玻璃杯，还有圆圆的白色茶碗！”这里有必要区分一下 cup（带托碟的茶杯）和
tall blue mugs,
，因为 mug 指的是杯壁更厚的圆柱形大杯（马克杯），通常下面不配托碟。
Thin cups look pretty, Hannah, but tea goes cold in three minutes.
“精致的杯子看起来是很美，汉娜，但茶三分钟就凉了。”当饮品或食物散失热量变凉时，使用
goes cold
非常地道，其中 go 表示这种不太理想的状态变化。
Try the thick cream-white stoneware on the left shelf.
“试试左边架子上那种厚实的乳白色粗陶器吧。”这种经高温烧制的致密陶器叫做
cream-white stoneware
，它由 stone（石头）和 ware（器皿）组合而成。
Oh, hello, Caleb! Your brother is right behind us holding the honey.
“哦，嗨，凯莱布！你哥哥就跟在我们后面不远处，手里正提着蜂蜜呢。”要表示某人就在我们身后几步远的地方，可以用
right behind us
，后面接动名词 holding 来描述手里拿着什么。
Feel the handle on this cup. Thick clay holds heat and never chips easily.
“摸摸这只杯子的把手。厚陶土很保温，而且不容易磕崩。”要表达某种材料能够保持温度，这里用到了
holds heat
，而 chip 则用来形容瓷器或陶器边缘磕出的小缺口。
And listen to that soft clink when you set it on the saucer!
“再听听把它放到托碟上时那声轻柔的叮当声！”陶瓷或玻璃相碰时发出的清脆短促声响有个专门的词：
soft clink
，而 saucer 特指垫在茶杯下面的小托碟。
Quiet saucers mean guests can hear Evelyn's piano across the room.
“安静的托碟意味着客人们在厅堂另一头也能听到伊芙琳的钢琴声。”要表达从房间一端跨到另一端，只需要用
across the room.
，不需要再额外添加其他介词。
Even when buying teacups, Caleb thinks like an acoustic architect!
“连买茶杯的时候，凯莱布都在像声学建筑师一样思考！”在
Even when buying teacups,
中把 when 保留在动名词前面，既不用重复主语，又显得非常流畅自然。
If we buy twelve cups and twelve saucers together, is there a discount?
“如果我们一起买十二个杯子和十二个托碟，有折扣吗？”在任何集市或商店里，礼貌议价的关键问句就是
is there a discount?
，注意在 discount 前面加上不定冠词 a。
Look at the chalk sign: ten percent off a full dozen!
“看那块粉笔牌：买满一打享九折优惠！”在商业标牌上，用
ten percent off
可以非常简洁地标明折扣百分比，其中 off 表示从原价中减掉的部分。
Plus a matching white milk jug on the side. Wrap them in newspaper.
“另外再加一个配套的白色小奶罐。请用旧报纸包一下。”当两件物品在颜色或风格上相配时，可以用形容词
matching
，它由动词 match 派生而来。
Packed and paid! Do not forget Graham's black tape on the way home!
“打包付完款啦！回家的路上别忘了买格雷厄姆要的黑色胶带！”头韵词组
Packed and paid!
在踏上归途（on the way home）前用明快的节奏为这次采购画上句号。让我们再完整听一遍这段对话。
Look at all these cups, Tessa: tall blue mugs, thin glass cups, round white bowls!
Thin cups look pretty, Hannah, but tea goes cold in three minutes.
Try the thick cream-white stoneware on the left shelf.
Oh, hello, Caleb! Your brother is right behind us holding the honey.
Feel the handle on this cup. Thick clay holds heat and never chips easily.
And listen to that soft clink when you set it on the saucer!
Quiet saucers mean guests can hear Evelyn's piano across the room.
Even when buying teacups, Caleb thinks like an acoustic architect!
If we buy twelve cups and twelve saucers together, is there a discount?
Look at the chalk sign: ten percent off a full dozen!
Plus a matching white milk jug on the side. Wrap them in newspaper.
Packed and paid! Do not forget Graham's black tape on the way home!
十二个厚实的粗陶茶杯、配对的静音托碟和一个配套小奶罐都用报纸包好了，也没忘记格雷厄姆的绝缘胶带。现在让我们回旅馆吧。
Bye for now!
